Chapter 6151: Diamond Touch

Chapter 6151: Diamond Touch

“They’re not holding back!” Ancestors and big shots were horrified at the massacre.

“A war between two dynasties will only harm the people.” An ancestor murmured.

The emperors cared not for the casualties and the unleashed devastation. The normally imperious sects and kingdoms were just as fragile as the rest.

Therefore, anyone who had hoped for war was ignorant of their helplessness. Just one strike from an emperor would reduce them to ashes.

“Bam!” A palm appeared in the air and repelled their auras. It swept through a billion miles, pushing the stars outward.

The emperors became alarmed. Diamond Emperor roared: “Diamond Touch!”

His physique reached its limit and became an unbreakable diamond fortress.

“Boom!” Six-tiger and Yin-eye Emperor staggered backward before vomiting blood.

If it wasn’t for Diamond Emperor’s defense, that palm earlier could have crushed them.

“Strategy Ancestor!” An old man stood inside Enigma Dynasty, supported by a walking stick. His white hair was combed neatly.

The radiance from his eyes reached all of Enigma, making everyone feel safe.

“Strategy Ancestor!” The dynasty’s inhabitants cheered excitedly.

He has always been in charge and played a large part in the dynasty’s prosperity. Secret and Hidden Ancestor were never around.

“I take it you wish for war.” Strategy Ancestor spoke softly but all could hear him.

“It is time for Enigma to be destroyed.” Six-tiger Emperor spoke matter-of-factly. His bestial aura pierced bone-deep, making others shudder.

“With just you three?” Strategy said domineeringly.

The trio became frozen because Strategy was qualified to look down on them. He was at the apex while the strongest among them only had twelve dao fruits. In other words, it wouldn’t be surprising for him to kill all three.

Strategy gave chase and blocked their escape path.

“I’ll spar with you.” Another emperor appeared, causing the ground to sink due to an invisible pressure.

“Allmountain Emperor!” Spectators felt the force of countless mountains pushing down on the area.

“From truth to origination!” Someone shouted.

“Immortal Suppression is not messing around this time.” The big shots could see that this was a determined assault.

Strategy Ancestor’s expression darkened because there was a one-level gap between him and Allmountain. Nevertheless, he couldn’t back down now.

“So be it, we will see who is stronger between us.” Strategy resorted to mustering all of his strength.

“Indeed.” Allmountain took one step forward and the ground couldn’t withstand his presence.

With Strategy occupied, Six-tiger Emperor entered Enigma and issued a challenge: “Anyone wishes to fight?”

“Kill him!” Members of the dynasty had no option but to fight. Desolate gods led battalions forward.

“Come.” Six-tiger spoke and turned into an ice tiger, immediately freezing ancestors and lords before they could get close.

“Break!” The strongest desolate god of Enigma roared and summoned a sun to nullify the freezing aura.

“Interesting.” Yin-eye Emperor entered the battlefield and said: “I wonder how many more hidden masters are here.”

“Boom!” He opened his third eye to initiate the devouring effect.

“Seal!” Other desolate gods became alarmed, unable to seal the eye despite their best efforts.

“Where are their emperors?” Spectators didn’t know why Enigma was missing their emperors.
